skills.name: Enforce relational integrity
skills.description: Designs a schema that preserves stated business invariants under valid and adversarial writes.
behaviors: Derives candidate keys and functional dependencies from an explicit business contract and justifies a lossless decomposition without assuming normalization alone enforces every invariant.
Implements and tests primary, unique, foreign-key, NOT NULL and CHECK constraints, including nullable inputs and transaction-boundary violations.
Distinguishes row-local constraints from cross-row invariants and demonstrates a counterexample when the proposed schema does not enforce the latter.

skills.name: Choose atomic transaction boundaries
skills.description: Preserves an explicitly scoped multi-write business operation across rollback and partial failure.
behaviors: Places all database writes for a stated invariant inside one transaction and demonstrates complete rollback after a failure between writes.
Reproduces a partial-commit failure caused by autocommit or an incorrect transaction boundary and verifies the corrected committed state from another connection.
Distinguishes a committed database transaction from an uncoordinated external effect and identifies the uncertain outcome after connection loss at commit.

skills.name: Reproduce isolation anomalies
skills.description: Uses controlled concurrent transaction histories to distinguish isolation guarantees and preserve a specified invariant.
behaviors: Constructs a barrier-coordinated two-session lost-update history and verifies both the anomaly and a correction on changed input values.
Distinguishes nonrepeatable reads, predicate-result phantoms and write skew using explicit snapshots and transaction histories for a pinned PostgreSQL isolation level.
Demonstrates that a cross-row invariant can fail under snapshot isolation and verifies that a serializable transaction strategy either preserves it or returns a retryable serialization failure.

skills.name: Resolve transactional conflicts safely
skills.description: Selects and verifies a locking or version-check protocol with bounded conflict recovery and preserved business effects.
behaviors: Implements a version-checked update that detects a stale writer by affected-row count and retries the whole business transaction without losing a concurrent update.
Uses a stated lock acquisition order to repair a reproduced deadlock while preserving all required writes, and identifies gaps when a predicate has no existing row to lock.
Classifies serialization failure and deadlock signals separately from validation errors, and verifies bounded whole-transaction retries with rollback and no duplicated external effect.

skills.name: Evaluate query and index trade-offs
skills.description: Uses reproducible query-plan evidence to improve a specified workload while preserving result semantics.
behaviors: Captures EXPLAIN evidence with pinned schema, data distribution, statistics, parameters and PostgreSQL version, and identifies the actual scan and join operations rather than equating an index with speed.
Compares a justified index and query rewrite on selective and nonselective inputs, verifying identical results including duplicates and NULL cases.
Measures the read, write, storage and maintenance effects of a candidate index and explains when the planner can reasonably prefer a sequential scan.

skills.name: Preserve effects under duplicate requests
skills.description: Implements a bounded database-backed workflow with explicit duplicate, crash and delivery semantics.
behaviors: Atomically binds an idempotency key and request fingerprint to the business writes and saved result; identical replay returns the prior result and conflicting key reuse is rejected.
Coordinates an outbox entry with the business transaction and demonstrates eventual at-least-once delivery with consumer-side deduplication, without claiming globally exactly-once transport.
Reproduces crashes before commit, after commit before reply and after delivery before acknowledgement, verifying one effective scoped business transition under retries.
